name: Dan
description: Jacob's son living at the time of the Patriarchs

points: The tribe of Dan was absorbed into the other tribes, and chiefly into Benjamin; that is part of why Benjamin had so many slave revolts, and successful ones.

note.label: Genesis 49: What Shall Befall the Twelve Tribes in the Last Days

points: Dan shall judge his people, as one of the tribes of Israel. Dan shall be a serpent by the way, an adder in the path, that biteth the horse heels, so that his rider shall fall backward: Dan was like an ambush to the enemies, a powerful tribe that did not play.

note.label: Genesis 49: What Shall Befall the Twelve Tribes in the Last Days
